post_slowdown_asr_text: So would this experience help the AI when it was asked to work again? The researchers compared 13 AIs with island experience. They also used 13 AIs with the same setup, but no experience. On a new island, the task was to build as many towers as possible in one hour. Each tower had to be five blocks high. The researchers checked which AIs could build more than two towers. The experienced group did better. Those that had taken a detour were now one step ahead.
